title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses direct string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical security vulnerabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential data breach, unauthorized account access, financial fraud
suggested_approach: Replace concatenated SQL with parameterized queries using SqlCommand.Parameters in C# implementation
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database operations
Penetration testing validates SQL injection protection

title: Implement Input Validation and Sanitization
problem_statement: User inputs are used directly without validation, type checking, or sanitization
risk_if_unaddressed: Invalid data processing, application crashes, potential security exploits
suggested_approach: Implement server-side validation with data annotations and client-side validation in C# web application
success_criteria: Account numbers validated as numeric and within valid range
Deposit amounts validated as positive decimal values
Comprehensive error messages for invalid inputs
Unit tests cover all validation scenarios

title: Define Target Database Schema and Migration Strategy
problem_statement: Target database schema and migration path from legacy VB6 structures are undefined
risk_if_unaddressed: Data loss during migration, incompatible schema design, extended downtime
suggested_approach: Design Entity Framework models, create migration scripts, implement rollback procedures
success_criteria: Complete schema mapping from VB6 to C# entities
Tested migration scripts with rollback capability
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed legacy system

title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: No authentication or authorization mechanisms visible in legacy banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking functions, regulatory compliance violations
suggested_approach: Implement JWT-based authentication with role-based authorization for banking operations
success_criteria: User authentication required for all banking operations
Audit logging for all authenticated operations

title: Add Comprehensive Error Handling and Transaction Management
problem_statement: Legacy code lacks error handling and transaction management for database operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Data corruption, partial updates, poor user experience during failures
suggested_approach: Implement try-catch blocks, database transactions, and user-friendly error messages
success_criteria: All database operations wrapped in transactions
